settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_EVIDENCE_LIFETIME_SECONDS
settings.description: The longest lifetime the attester accepts of a piece of evidence: of the whole (exp - iat) when it has an iat, and of what is left (exp - now, with 60 s for a clock behind the issuer's) always; a binding lives as long as its evidence, so this bounds how long a stolen token stays presentable. Production may only shorten it

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number of seconds from 1, or above 86400 without OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable (before 0.6.0 each issuance answered 500 server_error from the first request)

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_REQUIRE_SINGLE_AUDIENCE_EVIDENCE
settings.description: Whether evidence whose aud names more than one party is refused: such evidence is presentable to each of them, so the attester cannot know it was the intended one

when_wrong.detail: Neither true nor false, in any case: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable (under development yes, no, 1, 0, on and off are read as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling); before 0.6.0 each issuance answered 500 server_error from the first request, in both profiles

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_GKE_SA_TOKEN_ISSUERS
settings.description: The issuers gke-sa-token evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: the GKE clusters' issuers, https://container.googleapis.com/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/clusters/CLUSTER. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them

when_wrong.detail: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development any GKE cluster issuer of that shape is accepted, with one warning

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_GCP_ID_TOKEN_ISSUERS
settings.description: The issuers gcp-id-token evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: https://accounts.google.com, the issuer Google always sets on a service-account ID token. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them

when_wrong.detail: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development https://accounts.google.com is accepted, with one warning

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_EKS_SA_TOKEN_ISSUERS
settings.description: The issuers eks-sa-token evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: the EKS clusters' issuers, https://oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/ID. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them

when_wrong.detail: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development any EKS cluster issuer of that shape is accepted, with one warning

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_AWS_STS_WEB_IDENTITY_ISSUERS
settings.description: The issuers aws-sts-web-identity evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: the accounts' STS issuers, https://ID.tokens.sts.global.api.aws. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them

when_wrong.detail: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development any account issuer of that shape is accepted, with one warning

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_AKS_SA_TOKEN_ISSUERS
settings.description: The issuers aks-sa-token evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: the AKS clusters' issuers, as az aks show --query oidcIssuerProfile.issuerUrl prints them. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them

when_wrong.detail: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development any issuer on https://REGION.oic.prod-aks.azure.com/TENANT/ID/ is accepted, with one warning

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_AZURE_MI_TOKEN_ISSUERS
settings.description: The issuers azure-mi-token evidence may come from, space- or comma-separated: the tenants' Entra issuers, https://sts.windows.net/TENANT/ (v1 tokens) or https://login.microsoftonline.com/TENANT/v2.0. A token whose iss is not one of them is refused (invalid_svid); a client's attestation_evidence_issuer may only name one of them

when_wrong.detail: A value that is not an https URL with a host and no query or fragment, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every client of the type is refused (invalid_client, naming the variable, with one warning); under development either Entra issuer shape, whose tenant the token's tid must then equal is accepted, with one warning

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_CLOUD_TOKEN_LIFETIME_SECONDS
settings.description: The longest a cloud evidence token may be issued to live (exp - iat), for the six cloud types; a longer-lived token is refused (invalid_svid). OIDF_ATTESTER_MAX_EVIDENCE_LIFETIME_SECONDS still caps every piece of evidence

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number of seconds from 60 to 86400: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_GCP_PROJECTS
settings.description: The Google Cloud project IDs whose workloads may present gcp-id-token and gke-sa-token evidence, space- or comma-separated, each a literal project ID and never a pattern: a gcp-id-token email must be a user-managed account of one of them, a gke-sa-token's cluster issuer and a *.svc.id.goog trust domain must name one; production refuses gcp-id-token without it

when_wrong.detail: A value that is not a project ID (6 to 30 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, a letter first, no hyphen last; a * is refused), or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable. Unset: under production every gcp-id-token client is refused (invalid_client); under development no project is checked

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_AWS_ACCOUNTS
settings.description: The AWS account IDs whose roles may present aws-sts-web-identity evidence, space- or comma-separated; unset, any account whose pinned issuer signed the token

when_wrong.detail: A value that is not twelve digits, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_AZURE_TENANTS
settings.description: The Entra tenant IDs azure-mi-token evidence may carry in tid, and aks-sa-token evidence when it carries one, space- or comma-separated; unset, an azure-mi-token's tid must be the tenant of its pinned issuer

when_wrong.detail: A value that is not a GUID, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTER_AZURE_MANAGED_IDENTITIES
settings.description: The object IDs (oid) of the managed identities that may present azure-mi-token evidence, space- or comma-separated; unset, any managed identity of an accepted tenant, its oid still required

when_wrong.detail: A value that is not a GUID, or a list of nothing: the issuance servlet's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the variable
